defs.def: the system of money that a country uses 通货；货币

ex.s: What does the underlined word ＂currency＂ in paragraph 4 refer to?
ex.t: 第4段中加下划线的“currency”一词指的是什么？

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: Bitcoin and other so called crypt currencies have been all over the news lately.
ex.t: 比特币和其他所谓的加密货币最近充斥着新闻。

ex.s: So while some of the world's first coins were made from a naturally occurring hybrid of gold and silver called electrum, objects other than coins have served as currency, including beads, ivory, livestock, and cowrie shells.
ex.t: 因此，尽管世界上最早的一些硬币是由黄金和白银的天然混合物——金银合金制成的，但除硬币外的其他物品也曾被用作货币，包括珠子、象牙、牲畜和贝壳。

ex.s: Once marooned out on their islands, locals needed a currency to use among themselves, and so the shell currency was born.
ex.t: 一旦被困在自己的岛上，当地人就需要一种在他们之间使用的货币，于是贝壳货币诞生了。

ex.s: And just like crypto currencies, there are those who think the islanders are smart to invest in this type of money, which is reported to have risen in value over the last three decades.
ex.t: 只是一张专门印刷的纸和大麻纤维，我们赋予了它价值——而且随着时间的推移可能比那些贝壳更不耐用。

ex.s: They use the same flag, known as the Union Jack, as well as share the same currency and military defence.
ex.t: 他们使用同一面国旗（被称为联合旗），并共享同样的货币和军事防御。

ex.s: The shape of jiaozi is also similar to the currency used in ancient China, so it is believed that they will bring wealth and prosperity3.
ex.t: 饺子的形状也类似中国古代使用的货币，因此人们相信它们会带来财富和繁荣。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定的贝壳仍然作为货币使用——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币模具一样，相信有一天，它将使他们变得富有，超越想象。

ex.s: But I imagine that, while money is indeed wonderful and necessary, rereading an author’s work is the highest currency a reader can pay them.
ex.t: 但我想，虽然金钱确实美好且必不可少，但重读一位作者的作品，是读者能给予他们的最高回报。

defs.def: the fact that sth is used or accepted by a lot of people 通用；流行；流传
